description: (tikajs-u03v, Fixer D) Adapted from xberg (MIT) crates/xberg/tests/html_declared_charset.rs: a legacy-encoded page is read in the charset its meta declares (misleading-content-without-http-equiv); no U+FFFD. Tika 4.2.0 (oracle) takes the first declaration, content="charset=shift_jis" included, finds the bytes malformed in it and falls to the statistical answer: windows-1252 (trace HtmlEncodingDetector->Shift_JIS[DECLARATIVE], MojibusterEncodingDetector->windows-1257[STATISTICAL] [junk-filter-selected]).
